highlight.title: Cloud Run's Agentic Era: GPU Support and Agent Platform Integration
highlight.summary: <cite index='3-1,3-7'>Cloud Run now supports NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs for high-performance AI inference on up to 70B+ parameter models, while integrating with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for production-grade AI agent deployment.</cite> <cite index='1-13,3-12'>The fully managed remote MCP server is now generally available, enabling easy deployments from developers and AI agents.</cite>

resources.title: Cloud Run Worker Pools and CREMA: Powering Serverless AI at Scale
resources.why_now: <cite index='4-27,4-28'>Worker pools provide 'always-on' environments for pull-based, non-HTTP workloads like AI inference, scaling based on external signals rather than request traffic.</cite> <cite index='4-30'>Google open-sourced CREMA (Cloud Run External Metrics Autoscaler) built on KEDA for queue-aware autoscaling.</cite>

resources.title: GCP Cost Optimization Best Practices & Why They Don't Scale
resources.why_now: <cite index='11-4,12-17'>Traditional cost optimization (rightsizing VMs, spot instances) can cut compute costs by up to 91%, but fails at scale.</cite> <cite index='19-5,19-6'>Most GCP cost optimization guidance only addresses early-stage efficiency and doesn't handle how costs behave as environments stabilize.</cite>

resources.title: Agent Identity and IAM for the Agentic Enterprise Era
resources.why_now: <cite index='21-2,21-6'>Traditional IAM controls aren't built for autonomous AI agents that interact with sensitive data at machine speed.</cite> <cite index='21-17,21-18'>Agent Identity now supports IAM Allow/Deny policies (GA) and Gemini-powered IAM Role Picker for least-privilege access.</cite>

resources.title: Pub/Sub Client Library Deprecations and Migration Path
resources.why_now: <cite index='31-1,31-2,31-5'>The v2 Pub/Sub Ruby client library is deprecated effective July 31st, 2026, losing security and bug fixes.</cite> <cite index='31-19,31-22,31-23'>The v1 Go client library is also deprecated with the same timeline, requiring migration to v2 versions.</cite>

claude_take: 2026 marks GCP's pivot to AI-first infrastructure with Cloud Run leading the charge through GPU support and agent orchestration. While traditional cost optimization tactics still matter, the real challenge is architecting for unpredictable AI workloads that demand both performance and cost efficiency at scale.
